title: Akbar Tadap Uthe
body:
khaynchi pisar ke seene se barchi jo shaah ne
akbar tadap uthe haye akbar tadap uthe
<<DIVIDER>>
bete ka haal dekh ke shabbir ro diye
akbar tadap uthe haye akbar tadap uthe
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat ko is zaeefi mein kaise uthayenge
laashe ko mere kaise ye ghar le ke jayenge
dard e jigar ko bhool ke bas yehi soch ke
akbar tadap uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha jawan laal ko jis waqt khoon mein tar
aaya nazar jo shaah ko dam tod'ta pisar
apne jigar ko thaam ke shabbir reh gaye
akbar tadap uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz par pisar ki jo aaye shahe zamaan
kuch bhi nazar na aata tha tareekh tha jahan
shabbir khaa ke thokarein maqtal mein jab gire
akbar tadap uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi jo khaynchi shaah ne lekar ali ka naam
haalat pisar ki dekh ke rone lage imam
barchi ka phal jo reh gaya seene mein toot ke
akbar tadap uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ghamzada ka aagaya maqtal mein jab khayal
sughra ka haal soch ke badhne laga malaal
aur phir ukhadti saans mein hamsheer ke liye
akbar tadap uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi tha gham ke chadarein cheenenge ashkiyan
har bibi ye pukaaregi haye meri rida
jab ye khayal aagaya maa hogi sar khule
akbar tadap uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab waqt e nazha ran mein thi akbar ki hichkiyan
jab naujawan tha aakhri saanson ke darmiyan
hasrat se apne laal ko jab dekha baap ne
akbar tadap uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
izhaar ban mein jis ghadi zainab ko di sada
akbar ka dam nikalta hai jab ro ke ye kaha
jab ye kaha ke aake dilaasa to dijiye
akbar tadap uthe...
author: Ali Izhaar
